verdict.rationale: Autumn's docs provide extensive copy-paste code snippets for core payment/entitlement flows (check, track, attach, webhooks) plus a one-command CLI and a 'bun dev' quickstart, and community comments (e.g. praising ease of fixing billing bugs) suggest fast integration is plausible. However all examples are JS/TS only—no evidence of docs in other languages—and there's no independent benchmark confirming a full working payment flow can be stood up in under a day; missing for 10: multi-language SDK examples, a documented end-to-end 'day-one' tutorial, and independent hands-on confirmation of setup time.
